en-ielts-listening-u01.target: To begin with, we need to distinguish planting a tree from maintaining it. A new tree provides little shade during its first few years. As its canopy grows, it may help reduce heat on the pavement beneath it. However, this benefit depends partly on water, space and the choice of species. Our discussion will therefore move from planting targets to maintenance budgets. Finally, we will ask how a council can report survival rates instead of simply counting newly planted trees. These figures would describe different aspects of the same programme.
en-ielts-listening-u01.zh: 首先，我们需要区分种树和养护树木。新栽的树在最初几年几乎不能提供树荫。随着树冠长大，它可能帮助降低下方路面的温度。不过，这种益处在一定程度上取决于水分、空间和树种选择。因此，我们的讨论将从种植目标转向养护预算。最后，我们要问：市政部门如何报告树木成活率，而不只是统计新种了多少棵树？这些数字反映的是同一个项目的不同方面。

en-ielts-listening-u02.target: Some managers describe open offices as a simple way to improve collaboration. I can see why the idea appeals to them, particularly when teams need quick exchanges. Yet it is easy to overstate the benefit of constant visibility. Staff who analyse complex material may need long periods without interruption. A shared office is worth considering provided that quiet spaces are genuinely available. My purpose is not to defend one layout for every workplace. It is to ask which activities a design supports and which it makes harder.
en-ielts-listening-u02.zh: 有些管理者认为开放式办公室是改善协作的简单办法。我理解这个想法为什么吸引他们，尤其是团队需要快速交流的时候。然而，人们很容易夸大持续处于他人视线中的好处。分析复杂材料的员工可能需要长时间不受打扰。只要确实有安静空间可用，共享办公室就值得考虑。我的目的不是为适用于所有工作场所的某一种布局辩护，而是探讨一种设计支持哪些活动，又让哪些活动变得更困难。

en-ielts-listening-u03.target: Attendance at the evening workshop showed a modest decline after the room changed. This does not mean that learners lost interest in the subject. Several participants reported that the new venue required an additional bus journey. The organiser is considering an online replacement for one session each month. Up to thirty people could join it, although the usual group is smaller. In your notes, keep the distinction between the maximum capacity and the number normally attending. Otherwise, a short summary may sound precise while misrepresenting the evidence.
en-ielts-listening-u03.zh: 晚间工作坊换了教室后，出席人数小幅下降。这不意味着学习者对这个主题失去了兴趣。几位参与者表示，新场地需要额外换乘一趟公交车。组织者正在考虑每月把其中一次活动改为线上形式。最多可以有三十人参加，但平时的小组人数更少。记笔记时，要区分最大容纳人数和平常出席人数。否则，一份简短摘要可能听起来很精确，却曲解了证据。

en-ielts-listening-u04.target: Enter the research garden through the southern gate. The office is immediately on your left, opposite a small pond. Walk past the office and follow the path north towards the greenhouse. The seed store stands just beyond the greenhouse, on the same side of the path. Visitors should leave collected specimens at the reception desk rather than taking them directly into storage. Staff label each specimen before it is moved to the controlled room. This keeps the public route separate from the handling process.
en-ielts-listening-u04.zh: 从南门进入研究花园。办公室就在左手边，对面是一个小池塘。经过办公室，沿小路向北走，前往温室。种子库就在越过温室的位置，与温室在小路的同一侧。访客应把收集到的标本交到接待处，不要直接拿进储藏区。工作人员会先给每份标本贴标签，再将其移入环境受控的房间。这样就把公众行走路线与标本处理流程分开了。

en-ielts-listening-u05.target: I originally requested room sixteen for the training session. Actually, we now need room sixty because more staff will attend. The date remains the fourteenth of May, not the sixteenth. The receptionist has confirmed that the larger room is available that afternoon. We must pay a deposit of thirty pounds by Friday. The remaining fee will be calculated after the equipment list is finalised. Please update the room number on the invitation without changing the date.
en-ielts-listening-u05.zh: 我原先为培训申请了十六号房间。其实，现在需要改为六十号房间，因为参加的员工更多了。日期仍是五月十四日，不是十六日。接待员已确认，那天下午较大的房间可以使用。我们必须在星期五之前支付三十英镑定金。剩余费用要等设备清单确定后再计算。请更新邀请函上的房间号，不要改动日期。

en-ielts-listening-u06.target: Each soil sample should be placed in a clean container. Attach a label showing the location and collection date. Before measuring moisture, the laboratory keeps all samples under consistent conditions. This reduces variation caused by different storage temperatures. The final report should state the measurement method as well as the result. A value without its method may be difficult to compare with another study. Students must therefore complete both columns of the record sheet.
en-ielts-listening-u06.zh: 每份土壤样品都应放入干净的容器。贴上注明采集地点和日期的标签。测量含水量之前，实验室会将所有样品置于一致的条件下保存，以减少储存温度不同造成的差异。最终报告除了给出结果，还应说明测量方法。一个没有注明测量方法的数值，可能难以与另一项研究比较。因此，学生必须填好记录表中的两栏。

en-ielts-listening-u07.target: Maya proposes interviewing fifty residents about their travel habits. Leon agrees that interviews would provide detail, but he doubts they can complete fifty before the deadline. He suggests a shorter questionnaire instead. Maya points out that fixed answers might miss unexpected reasons for travelling. They eventually agree to survey a larger group and interview six volunteers afterwards. The interviews will explore issues raised by the survey rather than repeat every question. Their final design combines breadth with a limited opportunity for explanation.
en-ielts-listening-u07.zh: Maya 提议采访五十位居民，了解他们的出行习惯。Leon 同意访谈能提供详细信息，但怀疑能否在截止日期前完成五十次。他建议改用一份较短的问卷。Maya 指出，固定选项可能遗漏意想不到的出行原因。两人最终同意先调查一个较大的群体，再对六位志愿者进行访谈。访谈将深入探讨问卷调查中出现的问题，而不是把每道题再问一遍。最终设计兼顾了调查广度和有限的深入解释机会。

en-ielts-listening-u08.target: Today we have considered why repeated exposure alone may not produce flexible learning. Familiarity can make material feel easy even when a learner cannot explain it without prompts. Retrieval practice addresses this gap by requiring an answer before the source is reopened. Spacing such attempts across several days may also help, although the best interval depends on the material and the goal. Our classroom example illustrated a possible routine, not a universal prescription. Learners must still check mistakes and use knowledge in contexts different from the original exercise. The central message is therefore to combine recall, feedback and varied use rather than judge progress by the smoothness of rereading.
en-ielts-listening-u08.zh: 今天，我们讨论了为什么仅仅反复接触材料可能无法形成灵活运用的能力。熟悉感可能让材料显得很容易，即使学习者在没有提示时无法解释它。提取练习要求先作答，再重新打开材料，以此弥补这一差距。把这些尝试分散在几天内也可能有帮助，不过最佳间隔取决于材料和学习目标。课堂例子展示的是一种可行做法，而不是适用于所有情况的固定方案。学习者仍需检查错误，并在不同于原练习的情境中运用知识。因此，核心建议是结合回忆、反馈和多样化运用，不要凭重读时是否流畅来判断进步。

en-ielts-reading-u03.target: Seed banks are often described as secure archives of future crops. Yet storing seeds is not equivalent to preserving a crop indefinitely. Some species tolerate drying poorly, and even suitable seeds require periodic testing. Staff must sometimes grow new plants to replenish a collection, which creates further demands for land and labour. These practical limits do not make seed banks useless. They show why conservation strategies also include living collections and cooperation with growers. The paragraph therefore examines the limits of a single method rather than narrating the history of agriculture.
en-ielts-reading-u03.zh: 种子库常被描述为保障未来作物的安全档案库。然而，储存种子并不等于可以无限期地保存一种作物。有些物种不耐干燥，即使适合储存的种子也需要定期检测。工作人员有时必须种出新植株来补充收藏，这又增加了对土地和劳动力的需求。这些实际限制并不意味着种子库毫无用处，而是说明了为什么保护策略还包括活体种植保存，以及与种植者合作。因此，这一段讨论的是单一方法的局限，而不是叙述农业史。

en-ielts-reading-u04.target: A pilot reading club began in three libraries in 2024. Two of the libraries offered evening meetings, while the third met only on Saturday mornings. Participants could borrow the discussion book from the library. The organisers collected written feedback at the end of each month. They reported that some members wanted longer sessions. The report did not describe the programme's funding or compare the three libraries' costs.
en-ielts-reading-u04.zh: 一个试点读书俱乐部于二〇二四年在三家图书馆启动。其中两家提供晚间聚会，第三家只在星期六上午聚会。参与者可以从图书馆借阅讨论的书籍。组织者在每个月月底收集书面反馈。他们报告说，有些成员希望活动时间更长。报告没有说明项目的资金来源，也没有比较三家图书馆的成本。

en-ielts-reading-u05.target: The council offered grants for insulation in older homes. This intervention was intended to reduce winter heating demand. Owners of eligible dwellings could apply for help with roof and wall improvements. The retrofit programme did not cover every type of building work. In particular, decorative repairs remained the owner's responsibility. These limits matter when comparing the scheme with broader housing subsidies. Both support households, but they fund different activities and should not be treated as identical policies.
en-ielts-reading-u05.zh: 市政部门为老旧住宅加装隔热设施提供补助。这项措施旨在减少冬季供暖需求。符合条件的住宅业主可以申请屋顶和墙体改造资助。这项改造计划并不涵盖所有建筑工程，尤其是装饰性修缮仍由房主自行负责。在将它与范围更广的住房补贴比较时，这些限制很重要。两者都支持家庭，但资助的活动不同，不能视为相同政策。

en-ielts-reading-u06.target: Plants beside the busy road developed smaller leaves in this small observational study. The pattern is consistent with a response to environmental stress. However, the researchers did not isolate pollution from differences in soil or water availability. They therefore describe their explanation as tentative. A controlled comparison could help assess which factor accounts for the pattern. Until then, the study provides a reason to investigate further rather than proof of a single causal mechanism.
en-ielts-reading-u06.zh: 在这项小规模观察研究中，繁忙道路旁的植物长出了较小的叶片。这一现象符合植物应对环境压力的表现。然而，研究人员未能把污染的影响与土壤或水分供应差异区分开，因此将自己的解释称为暂定解释。对照比较可以帮助评估究竟哪项因素解释了这种现象。在此之前，这项研究提供的是继续调查的理由，而不是某一种因果机制的证明。

en-ielts-reading-u07.target: Section A defines a community survey as a structured collection of residents' views. It explains that a shared question set makes answers easier to compare. Section B describes a pilot in which volunteers distributed forms at a weekend market. Because people who stayed at home were not approached, the responses may underrepresent them. Section C recommends combining face-to-face distribution with an accessible remote option. It also advises reporting who was not reached, rather than presenting the sample as the entire community.
en-ielts-reading-u07.zh: A 部分把社区调查定义为有组织地收集居民意见，并解释统一的问题集为何使答案更容易比较。B 部分描述了一项试点：志愿者在周末市场发放问卷。由于没有接触留在家中的人，他们的意见在回答中可能代表不足。C 部分建议把面对面发放与方便使用的远程方式结合起来。它还建议说明哪些人没有被接触到，而不要将样本说成整个社区。

en-ielts-reading-u08.target: Passage A reports that average library visits rose in a fictional district after weekend opening was introduced. The increase is an aggregate result and does not describe every neighbourhood. Passage B presents interviews with residents whose bus service ends early on Saturdays. Several say that the new hours offer little practical benefit to them. The passages therefore examine different aspects of access rather than directly contradicting each other. A useful synthesis would acknowledge the average gain while identifying transport as a possible source of unequal benefit. Further data would be needed to estimate how common that barrier is.
en-ielts-reading-u08.zh: 文章 A 报告说，在一个虚构地区，图书馆开始周末开放后，平均到访量增加了。这是一个总体结果，不能代表每个社区。文章 B 则介绍对一些居民的访谈，他们所在地区的公交在星期六很早就停运。几位居民表示，新的开放时间对他们几乎没有实际帮助。因此，两篇文章探讨的是可及性的不同方面，并非直接互相矛盾。合理的综合分析应承认平均到访量增加，同时指出交通可能导致不同人群受益不均。要估计这种障碍有多普遍，还需要更多数据。

en-ielts-writing-task1-u02.target: The fictional series shows a fall followed by a sustained recovery. Monthly visits declined from 1,200 in 2020 to 900 in 2021. They then increased to 1,500 in 2022 and reached 1,800 in 2023. Overall, the final figure was 600 higher than the initial one. The data do not show a steady rise throughout the entire period. Nor do they identify why attendance changed. A concise report should describe the direction and scale before adding selected figures.
en-ielts-writing-task1-u02.zh: 这组虚构数据呈现了先下降、再持续回升的趋势。月访问量从二〇二〇年的一千二百降至二〇二一年的九百，随后在二〇二二年增至一千五百，并在二〇二三年达到一千八百。总体而言，最终数值比初始数值高六百。数据并未显示整个时期都在稳定上升，也没有指出访问量为什么变化。简明报告应先描述趋势方向和幅度，再补充精选的数据。

en-ielts-writing-task1-u03.target: Bus use was highest at campus B in the invented table. Half of its commuters used buses, compared with a quarter who cycled. Campus A showed the opposite ordering, with cycling at 40% and buses at 30%. At campus C, the gap was fifteen percentage points in favour of cycling. These figures cover only two transport categories. A report can compare the listed modes but cannot identify the missing categories without further information. The overview should emphasise the contrast between B and the other campuses.
en-ielts-writing-task1-u03.zh: 在这张虚构表格中，B 校区的公交使用率最高。其通勤者中，一半乘坐公交，四分之一骑行。A 校区的高低顺序相反，骑行占百分之四十，公交占百分之三十。C 校区骑行的占比高出公交十五个百分点。这些数字只涵盖两种交通方式。报告可以比较所列的方式，但没有更多信息就无法确定未列出的类别。概述应突出 B 校区与另外两个校区之间的差异。

en-ielts-writing-task1-u04.target: Teaching remained the largest category in both years of the fictional budget. Its share nevertheless fell from 50% to 45%. Research gained ten percentage points, rising from 30% to 40%. Facilities accounted for the remaining 20% and 15% respectively. The figures show a redistribution of shares towards research. They do not reveal whether the total budget expanded or contracted. Consequently, a lower share for teaching should not be reported as a confirmed fall in its monetary allocation.
en-ielts-writing-task1-u04.zh: 在这份虚构预算的两个年份中，教学始终是占比最大的类别，但其份额从百分之五十降到了百分之四十五。研究增加了十个百分点，从百分之三十升至百分之四十。设施分别占剩余的百分之二十和百分之十五。这些数字表明预算份额向研究重新分配，但没有说明预算总额是增加还是减少。因此，教学占比下降不应被表述为其实际金额已确定减少。

en-ielts-writing-task1-u05.target: The simplified process begins when used paper is collected from designated bins. It is sorted to remove materials unsuitable for the intended product. The selected paper is mixed with water to form pulp. After unwanted particles are removed, the mixture is spread into a thin layer. Water is pressed out and the sheet is dried. Finally, the material is cut for reuse. This is an original schematic description for writing practice, not a complete industrial specification.
en-ielts-writing-task1-u05.zh: 这一简化流程始于从指定回收箱收集废纸。随后对废纸分类，剔除不适用于目标产品的材料。选出的纸与水混合形成纸浆。除去杂质后，将混合物铺成薄层，压出水分，并将纸页干燥。最后，把材料裁切以供再次使用。这是为写作练习原创的流程示意说明，不是完整的工业技术规范。

en-ielts-writing-task1-u06.target: The invented layout compares a small public square before and after redevelopment. The car park in the north was replaced by a garden. On the western side, the café was extended into an adjacent vacant area. The library to the east remained unchanged. A new footpath was added along the southern boundary. Overall, the site gained green space and pedestrian access while retaining its library. No change to the library's size or function is specified in the description.
en-ielts-writing-task1-u06.zh: 这张虚构平面图比较了一个小型公共广场改造前后的布局。北侧的停车场被花园取代；西侧的咖啡馆向相邻空地扩建；东侧的图书馆保持不变；南侧边界新增了一条步行道。总体上，场地增加了绿地和步行通道，同时保留了图书馆。说明中没有提及图书馆面积或功能发生变化。

en-ielts-writing-task1-u07.target: Paper loans remained the dominant category in the fictional distribution. Their share fell from 80% to 60%, while digital borrowing rose from 10% to 30%. The remaining category stayed at 10%. This shift therefore involved the two main formats rather than all categories equally. Grouping the opposing trends in one sentence makes the comparison visible. A separate sentence can then report the stable category. Repeating the exact category names is preferable to replacing them with terms that imply a different activity.
en-ielts-writing-task1-u07.zh: 在这组虚构分布数据中，纸质借阅仍占主导地位。其份额从百分之八十降至百分之六十，而数字借阅从百分之十升至百分之三十。剩余类别保持百分之十。因此，这次变化涉及两种主要形式，而不是所有类别都同等变化。把方向相反的趋势放在同一句中，可以清楚呈现比较，再用另一句说明稳定不变的类别。重复准确的类别名称，比换用可能暗示另一种活动的词更合适。

en-ielts-writing-task1-u08.target: The practice table lists weekly visits of 20, 30 and 40 in three successive years. An initial draft incorrectly claims that visits doubled in the second year. In fact, they rose by half between the first and second years and doubled only across the full period. Another sentence attributes the rise to advertising, although the table provides no causal information. The revised overview states simply that attendance increased throughout the period. It then selects the starting and final figures to show the overall scale. Editing strengthens accuracy here without adding elaborate vocabulary.
en-ielts-writing-task1-u08.zh: 练习表格列出了连续三年每周访问量分别为二十、三十和四十。初稿错误地声称访问量在第二年翻了一番。实际上，第一年到第二年增加了二分之一，只有从第一年到第三年才翻了一番。另一句话把增长归因于广告，但表格没有提供任何因果信息。修改后的概述只说明，访问量在整个时期持续增加，再选择起始和最终数值展示总体幅度。这里的修改通过提高准确性来改善文章，并不需要添加华丽词汇。

en-ielts-writing-task2-u02.target: Accessible public spaces can support informal contact between neighbours. A shared place gives people a reason to remain nearby rather than pass each other without speaking. For example, a hypothetical courtyard with seating might allow carers to talk while children play. The example illustrates a possible mechanism; it is not evidence that every courtyard produces social trust. Poor maintenance or an unwelcoming design could undermine the benefit. A strong paragraph therefore explains both how the proposed effect could arise and the conditions under which it might fail.
en-ielts-writing-task2-u02.zh: 方便使用的公共空间可以促进邻里间的非正式交流。共享场所给人们一个留在附近的理由，而不是擦肩而过、一言不发。例如，一个假想的带座椅庭院，可能让照护者在孩子玩耍时交谈。这个例子说明了一种可能的机制，并不能证明每个庭院都会产生社会信任。维护不善或令人感到不受欢迎的设计，都可能削弱这种益处。因此，一个有力的段落既要解释所提出的效果如何出现，也要说明它可能在什么条件下无法实现。

en-ielts-writing-task2-u03.target: Supporters of standardised tests argue that common tasks make comparisons more consistent. This is a serious advantage when applicants come from different schools. However, consistency in scoring does not ensure that a test captures every relevant ability. Collaborative work, revision and sustained inquiry may require other forms of evidence. The objection does not imply that tests should be abolished. It supports combining them with carefully designed additional tasks. Such a position answers the strongest argument for tests while limiting the conclusion drawn from it.
en-ielts-writing-task2-u03.zh: 标准化测试的支持者认为，共同任务使比较更加一致。对于来自不同学校的申请者，这确实是一个重要优点。然而，评分一致并不保证测试能涵盖所有相关能力。协作、修改和持续探究，可能需要其他形式的证据。这项异议并不意味着应当废除测试，而是支持将测试与经过认真设计的补充任务结合起来。这样的立场回应了支持测试的最强论据，同时限制了从中能够得出的结论。

en-ielts-writing-task2-u04.target: One view holds that universities should prioritise vocational preparation because students need usable routes into employment. Another emphasises broad education, arguing that specific skills can become obsolete. The positions share a concern for students' futures but interpret preparation differently. A balanced judgement need not treat all programmes alike. Courses with direct professional responsibilities may require substantial practical training, while every student can benefit from learning to evaluate unfamiliar evidence. I would therefore support a curriculum that connects specialised practice with transferable reasoning. The appropriate balance should depend on the programme rather than a universal percentage.
en-ielts-writing-task2-u04.zh: 一种观点认为，大学应优先提供职业准备，因为学生需要切实可行的就业路径。另一种观点强调通识教育，认为具体技能可能过时。两者都关心学生的未来，只是对“准备”的理解不同。平衡的判断无须把所有课程项目一视同仁。直接涉及专业职责的课程可能需要大量实践训练，而每位学生都可以从学习评估陌生证据中受益。因此，我支持将专业实践与可迁移推理能力相结合的课程。适当的比重应由课程项目决定，而不是套用一个统一百分比。

en-ielts-writing-task2-u05.target: Moving routine services online can reduce travel and waiting time. For people who live far from an office, this convenience may be substantial. Yet a digital-only system can exclude users without reliable access or the confidence to complete complex forms. The seriousness of that exclusion matters more than the number of minor efficiencies listed in support of the system. In my view, the benefits can outweigh the drawbacks if assisted and non-digital routes remain available. Retaining these alternatives has a cost, but it protects access to essential services. The judgement is therefore conditional rather than a claim that technology is beneficial in every form.
en-ielts-writing-task2-u05.zh: 把日常服务转到网上，可以减少出行和等待时间。对离办事处较远的人而言，这种便利可能十分显著。不过，只提供数字渠道的系统可能排斥无法稳定上网，或缺乏信心填写复杂表格的人。这种排斥的严重性，比支持者列出多少项细小效率提升更重要。在我看来，只要仍保留有人协助的服务和非数字渠道，利就可能大于弊。保留这些替代方式需要成本，但能保障人们使用基本服务。因此，这一判断有前提条件，并不是声称任何形式的技术都有益。

en-ielts-writing-task2-u06.target: Peak-hour congestion may reflect the concentration of work and school schedules as well as limited alternatives to driving. Adding road capacity alone does not address either source completely. More frequent public transport could make another mode feasible for some commuters. Staggered start times could reduce the number travelling simultaneously, provided that employers and schools can coordinate them. Neither measure is costless or suitable everywhere. A credible proposal should specify which cause it targets, who must act and how its effects would be checked. Otherwise, a list of solutions may sound energetic while leaving the mechanism of the problem untouched.
en-ielts-writing-task2-u06.zh: 高峰期拥堵可能既源于工作和上学时间集中，也源于自驾之外的选择有限。仅增加道路容量，并不能彻底解决任何一项原因。提高公共交通班次，可以让部分通勤者有条件选择另一种出行方式。如果雇主与学校能够协调，错峰开始时间可以减少同时出行的人数。两种措施都不是没有成本，也不适用于所有地方。可信的建议应说明它针对哪项原因、谁需要采取行动，以及如何检验效果。否则，一串解决办法可能听起来积极有力，却没有触及问题机制。

en-ielts-writing-task2-u07.target: A school may offer music classes but charge a fee for instrument hire. This charge can prevent some pupils from participating, even when tuition itself is free. Removing the hire fee would address that specific restriction. It would not automatically resolve a shortage of teachers or rehearsal space. The phrase that specific restriction keeps the proposed response tied to the problem already identified. A following paragraph could then examine the separate resource constraints. Clear progression depends on these relationships, not on inserting a different linking expression at the start of every sentence.
en-ielts-writing-task2-u07.zh: 学校可能提供音乐课，却收取乐器租用费。即使教学本身免费，这项费用仍可能阻止一些学生参加。取消租用费可以解决这一特定障碍，但不会自动解决师资或排练空间不足。“这一特定障碍”把应对措施与前面已经指出的问题明确联系起来。下一段可以再讨论独立的资源限制。清晰的行文推进依赖这些关系，而不是每句话开头都换一个连接词。

en-ielts-writing-task2-u08.target: The first draft claimed that social media inevitably destroys genuine friendship. This statement combines an absolute outcome with an undefined standard of genuineness. A more defensible claim is that some patterns of use may displace time for face-to-face contact. The revision identifies a possible mechanism and narrows the scope. It also leaves room for online communication to sustain relationships across distance. Formal writing does not require the writer to avoid a position. It requires the strength and range of that position to match the reasons offered in its support.
en-ielts-writing-task2-u08.zh: 初稿声称，社交媒体不可避免地摧毁真正的友谊。这句话把绝对化的结果与未定义的“真正”标准结合起来。更站得住脚的说法是：某些使用模式可能挤占面对面交往的时间。修改后的表达指出一种可能的机制，并缩小了适用范围；它也承认线上交流可以维系远距离关系。正式写作并不要求作者回避立场，而是要求立场的强度和范围，与支持它的理由相匹配。

fr-a1-u04.target: Voici ma chambre. Il y a un bureau près de la fenêtre. Un livre est sur le bureau. Mon sac est sous la chaise. Sur l'étagère, il y a trois cahiers et une petite lampe. La chambre est petite, mais elle est claire. Le soir, je lis près de la fenêtre.
fr-a1-u04.zh: 这是我的房间。窗户旁有一张书桌。一本书在书桌上。我的包在椅子下面。架子上有三本练习本和一盏小灯。房间虽小，但很明亮。晚上，我在窗边看书。

fr-a1-u05.target: Je travaille dans une bibliothèque. Le matin, je commence à neuf heures. À midi, je mange avec une collègue. Nous parlons de nos livres préférés. L'après-midi, nous préparons les tables pour les étudiants. Le soir, j'étudie le français chez moi. Le vendredi, je termine plus tôt et je marche au parc.
fr-a1-u05.zh: 我在一家图书馆工作。早上九点开始上班。中午，我和一位女同事一起吃饭。我们聊自己喜欢的书。下午，我们为学生布置学习桌。晚上，我在家学习法语。星期五，我提前下班，去公园散步。

fr-a1-u06.target: Bonjour, je cherche la salle de français. Le cours est au deuxième étage. Est-ce que le cours commence à dix heures ? Non, il commence à dix heures et demie. Qui est le professeur aujourd'hui ? C'est Madame Martin. Merci, et où est l'escalier ? Il est à droite, près de l'accueil.
fr-a1-u06.zh: 你好，我在找法语教室。课程在二楼（按法国楼层计数，地面层之上第二层）。课程十点开始吗？不，十点半开始。今天的老师是谁？是 Martin 女士。谢谢，那楼梯在哪里？在右边，接待处附近。

fr-a1-u07.target: Le samedi, Léa aime nager. Son ami Hugo préfère faire une promenade. Ils aiment tous les deux le cinéma. Aujourd'hui, il pleut et ils choisissent un film. Léa n'aime pas les films très longs. Hugo propose une comédie de quatre-vingt-dix minutes. Après le film, ils prennent un thé et parlent de leur semaine.
fr-a1-u07.zh: 星期六，Léa 喜欢游泳。她的朋友 Hugo 更喜欢散步。两人都喜欢看电影。今天下雨，他们选了一部电影。Léa 不喜欢很长的电影。Hugo 提议看一部九十分钟的喜剧。看完后，他们喝茶，聊这一周的事情。

fr-a1-u08.target: Bonjour, je voudrais un kilo de pommes. Elles coûtent trois euros le kilo. Je prends aussi du pain et une bouteille d'eau. Au café voisin, je commande un thé sans sucre. Le serveur apporte la tasse et une petite cuillère. Je paie cinq euros pour le thé et le pain. Je remercie le serveur avant de partir.
fr-a1-u08.zh: 你好，我想买一公斤苹果。苹果每公斤三欧元。我还买面包和一瓶水。在旁边的咖啡馆，我点了一杯不加糖的茶。服务员端来茶杯和一把小勺。我为茶和面包支付了五欧元。离开前，我向服务员道谢。

fr-a1-u09.target: La bibliothèque est près de la gare. Sortez de la gare et allez tout droit. Au premier feu, tournez à gauche. Traversez la petite place. La bibliothèque est en face du musée. Son entrée est entre une pharmacie et un café. À pied, le trajet prend environ dix minutes.
fr-a1-u09.zh: 图书馆在火车站附近。走出车站，一直往前走。在第一个红绿灯处左转，穿过小广场。图书馆在博物馆对面，入口在药店和咖啡馆之间。步行大约需要十分钟。

fr-a1-u10.target: Nous partageons un petit appartement. Notre salon donne sur un jardin. Dans la cuisine, on prépare souvent le dîner ensemble. Après le repas, chacun range son assiette. Mes clés sont près de la porte. Le dimanche, ma colocataire travaille et je fais les courses. Nous aimons cette maison calme.
fr-a1-u10.zh: 我们合住一套小公寓。客厅朝向花园。我们经常在厨房一起准备晚饭。饭后，每个人收好自己的盘子。我的钥匙在门边。星期天，我的女室友工作，我去买东西。我们喜欢这个安静的家。

fr-a1-u11.target: Demain, nous allons visiter le musée de la ville. Je vais acheter les billets ce soir. Ma sœur va préparer un petit pique-nique. Nous allons nous retrouver devant la gare à neuf heures. Après la visite, nous allons manger dans le parc. Il va peut-être pleuvoir, alors je vais prendre un parapluie. Tu veux venir avec nous ?
fr-a1-u11.zh: 明天，我们要去参观市博物馆。我今晚会买票。我的姐妹会准备一份简单的野餐。我们要在九点到火车站前碰面。参观后，我们要在公园吃饭。可能会下雨，所以我要带伞。你想和我们一起去吗？

fr-a1-u12.target: Hier, je suis allée au centre-ville avec mon frère. Nous avons visité un petit musée. J'ai pris des photos dans le jardin. À midi, nous avons déjeuné dans un café. Mon frère a rencontré un ancien ami. Nous sommes rentrés à cinq heures. Aujourd'hui, je regarde les photos et je raconte notre sortie à une amie.
fr-a1-u12.zh: 昨天，我和我的兄弟去了市中心。我们参观了一家小博物馆。我在花园里拍了照片。中午，我们在咖啡馆吃了午饭。我的兄弟遇见了一位老朋友。我们五点回来了。今天，我在看照片，并把这次外出经历讲给一位女性朋友听。原文说话者使用了女性配合形式 allée。

fr-a2-u03.target: Le train direct pour Tours est annulé ce matin. Au guichet, une employée propose un trajet avec une correspondance à Orléans. Nous devons partir à onze heures et changer de quai à Orléans. Notre billet reste valable pour ce nouveau trajet. Si nous préférons partir demain, nous pouvons demander un remboursement. Nous choisissons de voyager aujourd'hui, car notre hôtel est déjà réservé. Avant de partir, nous vérifions le numéro du quai sur l'écran.
fr-a2-u03.zh: 今天上午，直达 Tours 的火车取消了。售票窗口的一位女工作人员建议我们经 Orléans 换乘。我们必须十一点出发，并在 Orléans 换站台。原车票对这条新路线仍然有效。如果更愿意明天出发，我们可以申请退款。我们选择今天出行，因为酒店已经订好了。出发前，我们在显示屏上核对站台号。

fr-a2-u05.target: Paul téléphone au cabinet pour prendre rendez-vous. Il explique qu'il est fatigué depuis deux jours. Il a mal à la tête, mais il ne connaît pas la cause. La secrétaire lui propose un rendez-vous dans l'après-midi. Elle ne donne pas de diagnostic par téléphone. Paul prévient son responsable et demande à rentrer plus tôt. Il note l'heure du rendez-vous pour ne pas l'oublier.
fr-a2-u05.zh: Paul 打电话给诊所预约。他说自己已经疲惫两天了。他头痛，但不知道原因。接待员给他安排了当天下午的预约，没有在电话里作出诊断。Paul 通知了负责人，并请求提前回家。他记下预约时间，以免忘记。

fr-b2-u03.target: Un titre affirme que les jardins partagés rendent les habitants plus heureux. L'enquête citée montre en réalité une association entre la participation à ces jardins et un indicateur de satisfaction. Elle repose sur des réponses volontaires recueillies dans trois quartiers. Les personnes déjà motivées par la vie collective peuvent être surreprésentées. Selon les chercheurs, une comparaison sur plusieurs années serait nécessaire pour examiner un éventuel effet causal. Le journaliste mentionne cette réserve, mais seulement en fin d'article. Une lecture critique doit donc relier le titre au protocole plutôt que retenir sa formulation la plus spectaculaire.
fr-b2-u03.zh: 一个标题声称，共享花园使居民更幸福。实际上，被引用的调查只显示参与这些花园与一项满意度指标之间存在关联。调查依据的是在三个社区自愿提供的回答。本来就热衷集体生活的人，可能在样本中占比过高。研究人员表示，需要开展跨年度比较，才能考察是否存在因果效应。记者提到了这一保留意见，却只放在文章末尾。因此，批判性阅读应将标题与研究方法联系起来，而不能只记住最吸引眼球的表述。

fr-c1-u07.target: Le titre demande pourquoi les habitants refusent enfin le changement. L'adverbe enfin suppose une attente antérieure, tandis que le verbe refusent homogénéise des positions peut-être diverses. Dans le corps de l'article, deux personnes contestent surtout le calendrier, non le principe du projet. La citation d'une opposante est exacte, mais son emplacement après une description alarmiste lui donne une portée particulière. Une critique précise doit distinguer cette construction éditoriale de l'invention de propos. Elle examinera aussi les voix absentes et les données permettant d'estimer leur importance. Il serait abusif de déduire d'un seul choix lexical une intention certaine du journaliste. On peut néanmoins montrer comment la combinaison du titre, de l'ordre des citations et des omissions oriente l'interprétation disponible au lecteur.
fr-c1-u07.zh: 标题问：为什么居民终于拒绝改变了？副词 enfin 预设了此前有所期待，而动词 refusent 把可能各不相同的立场归成一类。正文中，两个人主要反对的是时间安排，而不是项目本身。对一位女性反对者的引用是准确的，但把它放在危言耸听的描述之后，使这句话产生了特定的作用范围。精确的批评必须区分这种编辑安排与捏造言论，还应考察哪些声音没有出现，以及哪些数据可以帮助估计其重要性。仅凭一个词的选择就断定记者有某种明确意图，是过度推论。不过，我们可以说明标题、引文顺序和信息遗漏相结合，如何引导读者能够作出的理解。

fr-c2-u03.target: Dans le premier fragment original, une porte fermée protège le narrateur du vacarme de la rue : enfin, personne n'entrerait. Dans le second, écrit pour cet exercice, la même formule conclut le récit d'une attente interminable : enfin, personne n'entrerait. La répétition verbale ne produit donc pas une identité de sens. Le premier contexte fait de l'isolement un refuge, tandis que le second peut y faire entendre un renoncement. L'adverbe enfin hésite alors entre soulagement et amertume. Il serait toutefois prématuré de conclure à une ironie certaine sans examiner la totalité du second récit. Une lecture intertextuelle précise décrit d'abord l'élément repris, puis les déplacements de situation, de voix et de valeur. Elle distingue enfin la relation construite par notre exercice d'une filiation historique qui exigerait d'autres documents.
fr-c2-u03.zh: 在第一段原创片段中，一扇关上的门保护叙述者免受街头喧闹的干扰：“终于，不会有人进来了。”在为本练习撰写的第二段中，同一句话结束了漫长等待的叙述：“终于，不会有人进来了。”因此，相同措辞的重复并不产生相同的意义。第一种语境使独处成为庇护，第二种则可能让人听出放弃。副词 enfin 因而在宽慰和苦涩之间游移。不过，在考察完整的第二篇叙事之前，断定它必然具有反讽意味仍为时过早。精确的互文阅读先描述重复使用的元素，再分析情境、叙述声音和意义价值的变化。最后，还要区分练习中构造的文本关系与历史上的承继关系；后者需要其他文献支持。
